title: IEEE 802.11: Add Protected FTM Request/Response
description: Adds dissection of Protected FTM Request/Response action frames. Refactors existing (non-protected) FTM code for reuse (refactoring in its own commit). I attached a PCAP with example frames. Note, there are still unprocessed octets in these frames, I will submit future contributions to address those. Breaking it up to make the review process easier. way.
